10: /// ## What it does
11: /// Checks for uses of the builtin `exec` function.
12: ///
13: /// ## Why is this bad?
14: /// The `exec()` function is insecure as it allows for arbitrary code
15: /// execution.
16: ///
17: /// ## Example
18: /// ```python
19: /// exec("print('Hello World')")
20: /// ```
21: ///
22: /// ## References
23: /// - [Python documentation: `exec`](https://docs.python.org/3/library/functions.html#exec)
24: /// - [Common Weakness Enumeration: CWE-78](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/78.html)
25: #[derive(ViolationMetadata)]
26: pub(crate) struct ExecBuiltin;
27: 
28: impl Violation for ExecBuiltin {
29:     #[derive_message_formats]
30:     fn message(&self) -> String {
31:         "Use of `exec` detected".to_string()
32:     }
33: }

35: impl Checker<'_> {
36:     /// S102
37:     pub(crate) fn exec_used(&mut self, func: &Expr) {
38:         let is_exec = match exec_name_head(func) {
39:             Some(head) => {
40:                 let semantic = self.semantic();
41:                 let binding_id = semantic.resolve_name(head).or_else(|| {
42:                     semantic.lookup_symbol_in_scope(
43:                         head.id.as_str(),
44:                         semantic.scope_id,
45:                         semantic.in_forward_reference(),
46:                     )
47:                 });
48:                 match binding_id {
49:                     Some(binding_id) => {
50:                         let binding = &semantic.bindings[binding_id];
51:                         let could_be_exec = matches!(
52:                             &binding.kind,
53:                             BindingKind::Builtin
54:                                 | BindingKind::Import(_)
55:                                 | BindingKind::FromImport(_)
56:                                 | BindingKind::SubmoduleImport(_)
57:                                 | BindingKind::ClassDefinition(_)
58:                                 | BindingKind::FunctionDefinition(_)
59:                         );
60:                         could_be_exec
61:                             && semantic
62:                                 .resolve_qualified_name(func)
63:                                 .is_some_and(|qualified_name| {
64:                                     matches!(qualified_name.segments(), ["" | "builtin", "exec"])
65:                                 })
66:                     }
67:                     None => false,
68:                 }
69:             }
70:             None => false,
71:         };
72: 
73:         if is_exec {
74:             self.diagnostics
75:                 .push(Diagnostic::new(ExecBuiltin, func.range()));
76:         }
77:     }
78: }

80: fn exec_name_head(func: &Expr) -> Option<&ruff_python_ast::ExprName> {
81:     match func {
82:         Expr::Attribute(attribute) => exec_name_head(&attribute.value),
83:         Expr::Name(name) => Some(name),
84:         _ => None,
